sources.title: 杜学林《〈万历野获编〉明刊本说释疑》，《中国典籍与文化》2019年第2期，25–29页
sources.provider: 北京大学《中国典籍与文化》期刊文章页面（作者单位：西北大学文学院）
sources.quality_notes: The first-party journal article page directly exposes full bibliographic metadata, author, 2019 issue 02 pp25–29 and abstract; Northwest University first-party faculty profile independently lists the article. The scholar argues purported Ming print evidence is insufficient and Li Ciming's alleged Ming print was probably an old manuscript once held by Zhou Xingyi, later in Taiwan, potentially retaining Shen Defu's 1619 arrangement. This is the author's interpretation, NOT a directly inspected original manuscript/edition, NOT a claim the target 改造漏刻 passage is present in the 1619 layer, and NOT proof that no Ming print ever existed. No full paper or historical target leaf was consulted; terms early draft, manuscript, 1827 print, 1869 repair, 2002 facsimile stay separate. The old rkyfz.pku.edu.cn path redirects to an unrelated journal page; the exact ccj.pku.edu.cn/Article/info path correctly resolves the article.
